verdict.rationale: Aircall documents Messages endpoints for sending SMS programmatically (aircall-docs-10). It also documents messaging webhooks for tracking SMS activity (aircall-docs-11), which likely covers inbound messages. Both are one-line tutorial blurbs, and neither explicitly mentions delivery-status events, a core part of the story. Missing for 10: explicit delivery status callbacks (sent/delivered/failed), clear documentation of receiving inbound SMS through the API or webhooks, detailed endpoint reference, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
